# optimizelycmp_user (Data Source)

Looks up one user by email. It fails if there is no match or more than one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the user.

### Read-Only

- `first_name` (String)
- `full_name` (String)
- `id` (String) ID of the user.
- `last_name` (String)
